# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Selectable Peacekeeping Contingent uniforms.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Blue helmets for the Peacekeeping Contingent.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR: War Measures v3 (24.11.2026): crimes, evidence, exposure, observers, peacekeepers.
# Generated by E:/HOI4_Mod_Tools/mdcoldwar/development/tools/war_measures/war_measures_build.py; edit the generator.

# ---- people: removed at once and booked in the Imperia refugee ledger of the state's owner.
# State scope, ROOT = acting country. Input: temp COLDWAR_WM_share, COLDWAR_WM_dead. Numbers in thousands.
# A war cannot empty a region (Enes 24.11.2026): measures and flight together take at most a quarter of the
# people a state had when it was first hit (imp_ref_base_k; the Imperia refugee pass shares the counters). State scope.
COLDWAR_WM_room = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = imp_ref_base_k } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_room_k = imp_ref_base_k } }
	else = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_room_k = state_population_k } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_room_k = 0.25 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = imp_ref_drained_k } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_room_k = imp_ref_drained_k } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_WM_room_k min = 0 }
}
COLDWAR_WM_remove_people = {
	COLDWAR_WM_room = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = imp_ref_base_k } } set_variable = { imp_ref_base_k = state_population_k } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_k = COLDWAR_WM_share }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	add_to_variable = { imp_ref_drained_k = COLDWAR_WM_k }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_persons = COLDWAR_WM_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_persons = -1000 }
	add_manpower = COLDWAR_WM_persons
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead_k = COLDWAR_WM_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_flee_k = COLDWAR_WM_k }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_flee_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead_k }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_flee_half_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_flee_half_k = 0.5 }
	OWNER = {
		add_to_variable = { imp_civ_casualties_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead_k }
		add_to_variable = { imp_monthly_refugees_local_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_half_k }
		add_to_variable = { imp_total_refugees_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
		add_to_variable = { imp_m_r_statistic_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.imp_monthly_refugees_global_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_half_k }
	add_to_variable = { global.imp_total_refugees_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
	ROOT = {
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead_total_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead_k }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_dead_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead_k }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_flee_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_dead_k = COLDWAR_WM_dead_k }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_flee_k = COLDWAR_WM_flee_k }
	}
}

# ---- every crime starts here. State scope, ROOT = acting country.
COLDWAR_WM_begin = {
	ROOT = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_dead_k = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_flee_k = 0 }
	}
}

# ---- evidence (no dice). State scope, ROOT = perpetrator. Input: temp COLDWAR_WM_gain, COLDWAR_WM_kind.
# At 20 the story breaks. Otherwise every observer mission in the owner's or controller's country sees it.
COLDWAR_WM_add_evidence = {
	ROOT = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_story_src = PREV } }
	ROOT = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 1.5 } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_evidence = COLDWAR_WM_gain }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_count = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_kind = COLDWAR_WM_kind }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_evidence > 19.99 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_verified = 0 }
		ROOT = { COLDWAR_WM_story_breaks = yes }
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_OBS_witness = yes
	}
}

# ---- the story. Country scope = perpetrator. Needs variable COLDWAR_WM_story_src (the state) and temp COLDWAR_WM_verified
# (1 = published by observers, who saved the global event target COLDWAR_WM_story_verifier). People are kept in thousands (HOI4 variables end near 2.1 million).
COLDWAR_WM_story_breaks = {
	save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_perpetrator
	add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_market_shock = 4 }
	var:COLDWAR_WM_story_src = {
		save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_state
		OWNER = { save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_victim }
		if = { limit = { is_owned_by = PREV } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_home = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_home = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender }
			var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = { save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_pk }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_kind = COLDWAR_WM_last_kind }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_count = COLDWAR_WM_ev_count }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_dead = COLDWAR_WM_ev_dead_k }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_fled = COLDWAR_WM_ev_flee_k }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_total_dead = COLDWAR_WM_dead_total_k }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_loot = COLDWAR_WM_ev_loot }
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_verified = COLDWAR_WM_verified }
	# exposure: the evidence that came out, times 1.5 if observers verified it
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_x = COLDWAR_WM_evidence }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_verified = 1 } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_x = 1.5 } }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure = COLDWAR_WM_x }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_WM_exposure min = 0 max = 100 }
	COLDWAR_WM_update_stage = yes
	# observers who saw something and kept silent are named
	set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_complicit = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_silent^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_WM_story_complicit = COLDWAR_WM_silent^num }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_c = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = COLDWAR_WM_silent
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_c = 0 } } save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_story_accomplice }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_c = 1 }
			add_stability = -0.03
		}
		clear_array = COLDWAR_WM_silent
	}
	# what came out is out
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_evidence = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_dead_k = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_flee_k = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_loot = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 3 }
		mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
	}
	var:COLDWAR_WM_story_src = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = PREV } } OWNER = { add_war_support = 0.08 } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_WM.1 hours = 6 }
	}
}

# ---- exposure stages. Country scope. 25 Under Scrutiny, 50 Accused, 75 Pariah. Only acts when the stage changes.
COLDWAR_WM_update_stage = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure > 74.99 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure > 49.99 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_exposure > 24.99 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage = COLDWAR_WM_st } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st > 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 0 } } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_government = democratic NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_WM_scrutiny }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st < 1 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 0 } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_WM_scrutiny }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st > 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 1 } } }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_WM_accused
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_WM_accused_opinion }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st < 2 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 1 } }
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_WM_accused
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_WM_accused_opinion }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st > 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 2 } } }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_WM_pariah
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_st < 3 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage > 2 } }
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_WM_pariah
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_stage = COLDWAR_WM_st }
	}
}

# ---- productivity helper (MD). State scope. Input: temp COLDWAR_WM_pshare.
COLDWAR_WM_cut_productivity = {
	set_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = productivity_state_var }
	multiply_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = COLDWAR_WM_pshare }
	multiply_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = -1 }
	state_flat_productivity_change_effect = yes
}

# ---- observers see a crime. State scope, ROOT = perpetrator. Missions sit in the owner's and in the controller's country.
COLDWAR_OBS_witness = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_t_state = THIS }
	ROOT = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_last_state = PREV } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_n = 0 }
	OWNER = { COLDWAR_OBS_notify_missions = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { CONTROLLER = { NOT = { owns_state = PREV } } }
		CONTROLLER = { COLDWAR_OBS_notify_missions = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_WM_testmode }
		ROOT = {
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_t_host = THIS }
			COLDWAR_OBS_send_witness_event = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_n > 0 } }
		ROOT = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_watchers = COLDWAR_OBS_n }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OBS.2 }
		}
	}
}
# Country scope = host of missions.
COLDWAR_OBS_notify_missions = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_t_host = THIS }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = COLDWAR_OBS_missions
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
					COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes
				}
				COLDWAR_OBS_send_witness_event = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
# Country scope = observer. What it saw is kept in its own variables; the events read them back in their immediate block.
COLDWAR_OBS_send_witness_event = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_state = COLDWAR_OBS_t_state }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_host = COLDWAR_OBS_t_host }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_perp = ROOT }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_kind = ROOT.COLDWAR_WM_last_kind }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_dead_k = ROOT.COLDWAR_WM_last_dead_k }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_seen_flee_k = ROOT.COLDWAR_WM_last_flee_k }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_n = 0 } } ROOT = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_first = PREV } } }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_n = 1 }
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OBS.1 }
}

# ---- observer modifiers. Country scope (host or sender).
COLDWAR_OBS_recalc = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_host_pp = COLDWAR_OBS_missions^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_host_pp = 0.10 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_host_stab = COLDWAR_OBS_missions^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_host_stab = 0.02 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_host_ws = COLDWAR_OBS_host_stab }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_sender_pp = COLDWAR_OBS_hosts^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_sender_pp = 0.05 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions^num > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_host } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_host } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_host } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_host }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts^num > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_sender } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_sender } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_sender } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_OBS_sender }
	}
}

# ---- peacekeepers. The locked template, small like real contingents (about a third of a normal division). Country scope.
COLDWAR_PK_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PK_template } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Peacekeeping Contingent"
			is_locked = yes
			override_model = COLDWAR_PK_blue_helmet_entity
			priority = 2
			regiments = {
				Mot_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				Mot_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				Mot_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				Mot_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 3 }
			}
			support = {
				Mot_Recce_Comp = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				L_Engi_Comp = { x = 0 y = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PK_template
	}
}
# Two contingents of ROOT (the sender). HOI4 does not create units in foreign provinces ("Not allowed on enemy provinces"),
# so they are raised in the sender's capital and marched into the zone; the protection starts when they stand there.
COLDWAR_PK_spawn_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_uniform_choice = 1 } } }
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_medium = yes
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_medium = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_uniform_choice = 2 } } }
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_deep = yes
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_deep = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_uniform_choice = 3 } } }
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_medium = yes
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_deep = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_light = yes
		COLDWAR_PK_spawn_uniform_light = yes
	}
}
# Sender modifier. Country scope = sender.
COLDWAR_PK_recalc = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_pp = COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_pp = 0.10 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_xp = COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_xp = 0.02 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_sender } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_sender } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_sender } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_sender }
	}
}
# A zone ends. State scope.
COLDWAR_PK_release_zone = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_suspended
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_relief
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_zone } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_zone } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild } }
		OWNER = { subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_zone_n = 1 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_PK_zone_n min = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender }
			var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = { subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_zones = 1 } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_PK_zones min = 0 } }
		}
		clear_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender
	}
}
# All zones of one sender in one host. Host scope, event target COLDWAR_PK_snd = sender.
COLDWAR_PK_release_pair = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone
			has_variable = COLDWAR_PK_sender
			var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = { tag = event_target:COLDWAR_PK_snd }
		}
		COLDWAR_PK_release_zone = yes
	}
}
# Host task. Host scope. Input: temp COLDWAR_PK_t (0 none, 1 humanitarian aid, 2 refugee relief, 3 reconstruction).
COLDWAR_PK_set_task = {
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_aid } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_aid } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_rebuild } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_rebuild } }
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_relief
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild } }
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_task = COLDWAR_PK_t }
	COLDWAR_PK_apply_task = yes
}
COLDWAR_PK_apply_task = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_task = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_aid } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_aid } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_task = 2 } }
		every_owned_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone } set_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_relief }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_task = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_rebuild } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_host_rebuild } }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_PK_zone NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_rebuild }
		}
	}
}
# Shoot Back ends. Sender scope, event target COLDWAR_PK_tgt = host.
COLDWAR_PK_stand_down = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_shoot value = event_target:COLDWAR_PK_tgt } }
		meta_effect = {
			text = { remove_relation_rule_override = { target = [TAG] can_send_volunteers = yes } }
			TAG = "[COLDWAR_PK_tgt.GetTag]"
		}
		remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_PK_shoot = event_target:COLDWAR_PK_tgt }
		COLDWAR_PK_volunteer_recalc = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_PK_volunteer_recalc = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_vol_size = COLDWAR_PK_shoot^num }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_vol_size = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_shoot^num > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_volunteers } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_volunteers } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_volunteers } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PK_volunteers }
	}
}
# A whole peacekeeping mission ends. Host scope, event target COLDWAR_PK_snd = sender.
COLDWAR_PK_end_mission = {
	COLDWAR_PK_release_pair = yes
	remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_PK_senders = event_target:COLDWAR_PK_snd }
	save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_tgt
	event_target:COLDWAR_PK_snd = {
		remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts = PREV }
		COLDWAR_PK_stand_down = yes
		COLDWAR_PK_recalc = yes
	}
	diplomatic_relation = { country = event_target:COLDWAR_PK_snd relation = military_access active = no }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_senders^num < 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_t = 0 }
		COLDWAR_PK_set_task = yes
	}
}
# Tripwire: an enemy of the host takes a zone. State scope, ROOT = new controller.
COLDWAR_PK_overrun = {
	ROOT = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_story_src = PREV } }
	var:COLDWAR_PK_sender = {
		damage_units = { state = PREV org_damage = 0.8 str_damage = 0.4 ratio = yes army = yes }
		add_war_support = 0.10
		create_wargoal = { type = topple_government target = ROOT expire = 730 }
	}
	ROOT = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_last_kind = 15 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_evidence = 30 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_count = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_verified = 0 }
		COLDWAR_WM_story_breaks = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_PK_release_zone = yes
}

# ---- mission costs in MD's native weekly budget. Country scope. Called from calculate_additional_expense_rate in
# common/scripted_effects/00_money_system.txt (hook line "COLDWAR_WM_add_weekly_mission_expenses = yes"): this effect must always exist.
# Observer mission 0.15 billion a month, peacekeeping mission 0.4 billion a month, as weekly shares.
COLDWAR_WM_add_weekly_mission_expenses = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_wk = COLDWAR_OBS_hosts^num }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_wk = 0.0345 }
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_WM_wk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_wk = COLDWAR_PK_hosts^num }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_wk = 0.092 }
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_WM_wk }
	}
}

# ---- Crush Dissent: MD protest strength down one step (20) and radicalisation down 2. Country scope.
COLDWAR_WM_crush_protests = {
	subtract_from_variable = { protest_strength = 20 }
	clamp_variable = { var = protest_strength min = 0 max = 100 }
	subtract_from_variable = { protest_radicalisation = 2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = protest_radicalisation min = 0 max = 10 }
}
COLDWAR_WM_mark_plunder = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_plunder days = 730 value = 1 }
		set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_WM_flight days = 365 value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_plunder } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_plunder } }
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_plunder days = 730 }
}

		set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_WM_cd_free_fire days = 180 value = 1 }
		set_state_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_WM_flight days = 120 value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_free_fire } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_free_fire } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_by = ROOT }
	}
	add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_WM_free_fire days = 120 }
}

# ---- previews for the state window tooltips. State scope. What each measure would do here, in thousands of people.
COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = {
	COLDWAR_WM_room = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.015 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_plunder_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_plunder_d = 0.2 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_plunder_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_plunder_f = 0.8 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.04 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_free_fire_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_free_fire_d = 0.4 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_free_fire_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_free_fire_f = 0.6 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.015 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_cordon_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_cordon_d = 0.3 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_cordon_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_cordon_f = 0.7 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.08 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_sweep_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_sweep_d = 0.6 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_sweep_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_sweep_f = 0.4 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_relocation_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_relocation_d = 0.2 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_relocation_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_relocation_f = 0.8 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.01 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_defoliation_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_defoliation_d = 0.3 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_defoliation_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_defoliation_f = 0.7 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.02 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_bombing_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_bombing_d = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_bombing_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_bombing_f = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = 0.002 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_interrogation_d = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_interrogation_d = 0.8 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_interrogation_f = COLDWAR_WM_pv_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_interrogation_f = 0.2 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_money = state_population_k }
	divide_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_money = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_money = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_pf = productivity_state_var }
	divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_pf = 350 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_WM_pv_pf min = 0.2 }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_money = COLDWAR_WM_pv_pf }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_draft = state_population_k }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pv_draft = 30 }
}
# Country scope: previews for every state this country holds or fights for.
COLDWAR_WM_preview_war_states = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { is_controlled_by = PREV CONTROLLER = { has_war_with = PREV } } }
		COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = yes
	}
}
# ---- tooltip previews. State scope, ROOT = acting country. Input: temp COLDWAR_WM_share, COLDWAR_WM_dead; COLDWAR_WM_gain.
COLDWAR_WM_preview_people = {
	COLDWAR_WM_room = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_k = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_k = COLDWAR_WM_share }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_k > COLDWAR_WM_room_k } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_k = COLDWAR_WM_room_k } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_dead = COLDWAR_WM_p_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_dead = COLDWAR_WM_dead }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_flee = COLDWAR_WM_p_k }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_flee = COLDWAR_WM_p_dead }
}
COLDWAR_WM_preview_evidence = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_gain = COLDWAR_WM_gain }
	if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_government = democratic } } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_gain = 1.5 } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_after = ROOT.COLDWAR_WM_evidence }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_after = COLDWAR_WM_p_gain }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_evidence
}
# ---- the crimes. State scope, ROOT = acting country. Political power is paid by the caller (decision cost or button).
COLDWAR_WM_do_plunder = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_money = state_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_money = 1000 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_money = 0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pf = productivity_state_var }
	divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pf = 350 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_WM_pf min = 0.2 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_money = COLDWAR_WM_pf }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_money
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_prod_15
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_share = 0.015 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead = 0.2 }
	COLDWAR_WM_preview_people = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_people
	OWNER = { add_war_support = 0.02 }
	COLDWAR_WM_mark_plunder = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 8 }
	COLDWAR_WM_preview_evidence = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: War Measures: plunder in [This.GetName]"
		COLDWAR_WM_begin = yes
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_WM_p_money }
		ROOT = {
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_loot_total = treasury_change }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_ev_loot = treasury_change }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_pshare = 0.15 }
		COLDWAR_WM_cut_productivity = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_share = 0.015 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead = 0.2 }
		COLDWAR_WM_remove_people = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_kind = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 8 }
		COLDWAR_WM_add_evidence = yes
		COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = yes
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_share = 0.002 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead = 0.8 }
	COLDWAR_WM_preview_people = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_people
	COLDWAR_WM_mark_interrogation = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 8 }
	COLDWAR_WM_preview_evidence = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: War Measures: interrogation in [This.GetName]"
		COLDWAR_WM_begin = yes
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } OWNER = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_WM_intel_t } ROOT = { add_intel = { target = event_target:COLDWAR_WM_intel_t civilian_intel = 10 army_intel = 10 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_share = 0.002 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_dead = 0.8 }
		COLDWAR_WM_remove_people = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_kind = 9 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 8 }
		COLDWAR_WM_add_evidence = yes
		COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_WM_do_conscription = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_draft = state_population_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_p_draft = 30 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_WM_tt_draft
	add_resistance = 20
	add_compliance = -15
	COLDWAR_WM_mark_conscription = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 6 }
	COLDWAR_WM_preview_evidence = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: War Measures: conscription in [This.GetName]"
		COLDWAR_WM_begin = yes
		ROOT = { add_manpower = COLDWAR_WM_p_draft }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_draft_neg = COLDWAR_WM_p_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_draft_neg = -1 }
		add_manpower = COLDWAR_WM_draft_neg
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_kind = 10 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_WM_gain = 6 }
		COLDWAR_WM_add_evidence = yes
		COLDWAR_WM_preview_state = yes
	}
}
